title: Systematic optimization for production of the anti-MRSA antibiotics WAP-8294A in an engineered strain of Lysobacter enzymogenes
adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 source re-review closed rwk-complete-test-0001: current-paper WAP-8294A activity/yield evidence is row-level curated from XML/PDF prose and figure captions, the DRAMP link is adjudicated as literature-only/database-only for sequence/activity, and final mechanism claims are bounded to biosynthesis/phenotype context.

materials_exhausted.note: Bounded worker-2/4/6 repair reopened XML, PDF text, OA package NXML/PDF/images, DOCX/PDF supplements, locator indexes, and linked database/merged-output rows. No blocking owner-layer gap remains; chart-only full matrices are not fabricated.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 found one DRAMP literature link matching DOI/PMID/title. Because linked_sequence_records, linked_assay_records, linked_dramp_activity_records, and linked_experiment_records are empty for DRAMP29321, sequence/activity identity is preserved as database_only_no_primary_source rather than promoted to source_verified.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 repaired the empty parser output with 13 source-supported records: one cited anti-MRSA ED50 context row, two Bacillus subtilis inhibition-zone control rows, and ten current-paper vancomycin-equivalent WAP-8294A yield/activity rows with units, target, conditions, and locators. No current-paper toxicity row was locally supported.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 rejected the automated protein-synthesis/translation note and bounded mechanism claims to NRPS biosynthetic context plus Bacillus subtilis phenotypic control. No current-paper direct molecular mechanism assay is claimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: The original blocking ticket is closed because supported activity rows now exist, database-only DRAMP scope is explicit, source-review provenance is paper-specific, and no concrete blocking or major rework target remains.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The paper has no XML/PDF tables. Worker-2 repaired activity rows from primary Results prose and figure captions; chart-only full matrices were not converted into unsupported exact values.

DRAMP29321 is linked as a literature record only; no linked sequence/activity/experiment row exists in the packet, so it is preserved as database_only_no_primary_source rather than source_verified sequence/activity.
Local XML/PDF/supplements support production optimization and Bacillus subtilis indicator activity, not mammalian toxicity or direct molecular mechanism assays.
